name: pi-docker-sandboxes
description: Run Pi inside a Docker Sandboxes microVM
author: Guray Gurkan

scripts.build:cli: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.cli.json
scripts.prepack: if [ -f .source-checkout ]; then npm run build:cli; fi
scripts.typecheck: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; node --experimental-strip-types --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; PI_DOCKER_SANDBOX_E2E=1 node --experimental-strip-types --test test/e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e-receipt: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; node --experimental-strip-types --test test/e2e-receipt.test.ts
scripts.docs:dev: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; vitepress docs
scripts.docs:build: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; vitepress build docs
scripts.check: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.image:build: if [ -f .source-checkout ]; then npm run build:cli; fi; node bin/pi-dsbx.mjs image build
scripts.image:verify: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; node scripts/verify-image.mjs
scripts.release:check: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; node scripts/check-release.mjs
scripts.package:verify: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.smoke:fresh-install: test -f .source-checkout || { echo 'source checkout only' >&2; exit 1; }; node scripts/fresh-install-smoke.mjs
